description: A vertical stem with a left-curving top forming a loop at the upper left, paired with a separate curved stroke resembling a 'v' or hook shape on the right.
A Kulitan consonant glyph consisting of a main looped or curved baseline structure with a tilde-like or curl diacritic mark above the left section, and an elongated vertical stroke on the right side.
A vertical stem crossed at the top by a curved arch or umbrella-like shape, with a curved wavy or looped stroke attached to its right side.
A cursive Kulitan character composed of an intersecting loop on the left, an upward curved stroke over a wavy middle section, and a vertical tail pointing upward on the right.
A wavy, serpentine Kulitan character consisting of multiple undulating curves resembling a sideways 'w' shape.
A curved Kulitan glyph consisting of an arched or hook-like stroke on the left connected to a wavy, downward-extending tail on the right.
A Kulitan consonant glyph featuring a wavy upward-curving main stroke with two horizontal slash marks above it.
A complex calligraphic Kulitan glyph featuring a curved leading stroke, a wavy central stem or ligature, and a sweeping terminal line on the right.
A cursive, serpentine Kulitan character consisting of a continuous winding stroke with a hook at the top left, dipping down, looping, and rising to a higher termination on the right.
A cursive Kulitan glyph featuring a horizontal base line with a wavy looping pattern on the left, an upward curl at the top-left, and a sweeping upward stroke forming a hook shape on the right.
A vertical stem crossed at the top by an arched horizontal line, with a wavy, curved extension to the right resembling a lowercase cursive 'v' or hook shape.
A Kulitan consonant glyph consisting of an oval loop on the left connected to a wavy, upward-extending vertical stroke on the right.
The glyph consists of a curving horizontal base stroke that loops upward into a numeral-3-like shape on the left, connecting to a downward loop on the right.
A cursive Kulitan glyph featuring a central vertical-ish stroke crossed horizontally, with a sweeping upward arching line above and a looping wave shape to the right.
A Kulitan character consisting of a loop or circle on the left connected to a wavy, curved stroke extending downwards and upwards on the right.

The Kulitan glyph on the left features a curved, undulating calligraphic stroke that starts with a downward hook on the left, loops upward and over toward the right with an inner loop or wave shape, and ends in a tall vertical stroke on the right side.
A vertical stem crossed at the top by a curved stroke looping to the left, with an adjacent connected wavy or curly component on the right.
The Kulitan glyph on the left consists of a curved base line sweeping upward, with a looped letter form resembling a '3' connected to an angular upward stroke on the right.
The Kulitan glyph consists of the consonant base character 'ka' (represented by a wavy, loop-like shape) with a diacritic tick or line to the left, which modifies the inherent vowel to 'e' ('ke').
A cursive, flowing Kulitan character featuring a left-leaning loop connected to a horizontal bar and a rightward vertical stroke curving upward.
A cursive Kulitan character combining a curving arch, a wavy middle section resembling an 'm', and an upward-stretching terminal line on the right.
A curved, handwritten Kulitan character resembling a wavy horizontal line with an upward hook on the left and a vertical terminal on the right.
A cursive Kulitan character with a sweeping upward arching top stroke, looping down into a wavy baseline curve resembling a stylized 'w' or 'u' shape with a small crossbar loop.
A Kulitan glyph featuring a curved, arching baseline on the left with a wave-like loop continuing into an upward-pointing vertical terminal on the right.
A Kulitan character consisting of a curved base consonant glyph resembling the letter 'ga' with a superscript diacritic mark (pamudpod) above the first arch indicating the vowel /i/ or /gí/.
A cursive Kulitan consonant-vowel character featuring an upward initial loop/arc on the left, connected to a wavy, serpent-like downward and upward curved stroke ending in a tall right terminal.

The Kulitan glyph on the left features two horizontal baseline strokes, a connected wave-like or looped middle component, an upright vertical terminal stroke on the right, and a separate diagonal diacritic mark above the upper portion.
The Kulitan glyph on the left features a curved base consonant symbol accompanied by diacritics consisting of three short horizontal or slanting strokes above it and a small comma-like tick below.

The Kulitan glyph on the left features a curved base consonant character representing 'nga', combined with vowel diacritics (corporate or historical vowel marks placed above/around the base) to modify the sound to 'ngí/i'.

A cursive Kulitan ligature or character featuring a left-facing curved stroke, a central component with small loops or m-like waves, a dot/diacritic mark underneath, and a trailing upward-sweeping curve on the right.
A Kulitan glyph representing the syllable 'ti' or vowel 'i', consisting of a flowing cursive stroke with a diacritical acute accent mark above the middle section.
A cursive Kulitan ligature or character combining a consonant glyph with vowel modifiers, featuring a wavy horizontal stroke with a leading hook on the left and a sweeping upward stroke on the right.
A cursive Kulitan glyph representing 'dí' or 'î', consisting of a complex undulating stroke with a superscript diacritic mark above it.
A Kulitan consonant glyph with multiple diacritics, showing a main curved stroke with a small loop/hook on top and a subscript dot below.
A Kulitan consonant glyph with a vertical stem intersecting an arched horizontal stroke, accompanied by a superscript diacritic mark above and a wavy trailing tail on the right.

A Kulitan glyph featuring a vertical stem with a curved upper arch spanning to the right, ending in a wavy, upward-curving stroke, accompanied by a small diacritic mark below and to the left of the stem.
A Kulitan consonant glyph with a vertical stem intersected by a curved horizontal stroke, accompanied by a looped or wavy secondary component attached to the right.

The Kulitan glyph consists of a vertical main stem crossed near the top by a curved loop extending to the left, accompanied by a small detached comma-like diacritic mark at the lower left, and a connected or adjacent curved stroke on the right side.
The Kulitan glyph on the left features a curved base character resembling the consonant 'si' with a diacritic mark (an acute accent-like stroke) placed above it to modify its vowel sound to 'i'.
A cursive Kulitan consonant character resembling a stylized '3' or looping wave combined with an upward sweeping stroke and a small diacritic comma-like mark below.

A cursive, flowing Kulitan character representing the consonant 'm' with an 'i' vowel diacritic/sign modifying it, showing a horizontal base-like stroke crossed by loops and a prominent acute diacritic mark above the curve.
A cursive Kulitan glyph featuring a base consonant crossed by a horizontal slash with a wavy looping stroke on the right and a diacritic dot or stroke below.

A Kulitan consonant glyph representing 'pa' (or a similar consonant) with a superscript diacritic (pamudtod/kudlit) above it to modify the inherent vowel sound to 'i', corresponding to the transliteration 'pí/í'.
A cursive Kulitan glyph representing the consonant 'pa' with a superscript vowel diacritic (kulis) indicating the vowel 'u' / 'o', forming 'pú' or 'pû'.
A Kulitan consonant glyph resembling a loop connected to a wavy horizontal stroke with an upward-curving terminal on the right, accompanied by a superscript diacritic mark above the left loop.
A cursive Kulitan character consisting of a small diagonal tick or stroke at the bottom left, connected to a rounded loop, followed by a wavy or S-like curve extending upwards and to the right.
